claimLedger.claim: Offer ≥3 months supervised PFMT first-line for stress or mixed UI; ≥8 contractions 3× daily; consider PFMT for some stage 1–2 prolapse.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NICE · NG123 Urinary incontinence and pelvic organ prolapse in women: management · recommendations include 2019 updates
claimLedger.limitations: UK NICE pathway; access to supervised programmes varies

claimLedger.claim: Supervised PFMT should assess contraction and relaxation and tailor to discomfort/goals; offer ≥3 months for stress/mixed UI.
claimLedger.sourceSection: NICE · NG210 Pelvic floor dysfunction: prevention and non-surgical management · Published 9 December 2021
claimLedger.limitations: UK guidance; prevention and non-surgical scope

claimLedger.claim: Do not practise stopping urine midstream as exercise.
claimLedger.sourceSection: North Bristol NHS Trust · Pelvic floor exercises for women · not stated
